QUOTE: The thread is `.detach()`ed, so nothing joins it. Its only shared outputs are the task map and a broadcast.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the async ask worker (`run_async_ask`) as detached with nothing joining it, though it doesn't say outright that it is the only detached thread. Other threads are described as joined or reaped, so the contrast is clear.
